subject: Billing & Procurement: PO vs Marketplace + Invoice Requirements
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@acme-analytics.com>, Jason Lee <jason.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Billing & Procurement: PO vs Marketplace + Invoice Requirements

Hi Emily / Jason —

Great to speak with you both a few minutes ago. Quick recap and a handful of asks so we can get legal/vendor and billing aligned on next steps.

Call recap (high level)
- Acme Analytics wants Redwood for inference in a production ML feature (multi-region).
- Procurement preference: PO + Net terms is likely, but marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace) is also under consideration depending on discounts and tax handling.

Open items for procurement and billing ops — can you confirm the items below so I can loop in Sales Ops?
1) Commercial path: do you want a direct PO to Redwood (vendor invoicing) or would you prefer us to pursue listing/quote via AWS Marketplace?
2) Net terms: Is Net 30 acceptable? Do you require Net 45/60?
3) Invoice format: must the PO number appear on the invoice header or can it be listed in the invoice notes? Any required invoice fields (department code, cost center)?
4) Billing address and legal entity: please share the exact billing/legal name and address we should use on invoices (required for your AP setup).
5) VAT/Tax: do you need VAT shown on the invoice, VAT ID included, or a VAT-exempt flow?
6) Vendor setup: any specific vendor form or W-9/OVW documentation required from Redwood?

Attached: post-call-notes.pdf (brief meeting notes).

Next step: If you confirm PO path + invoice requirements, I’ll get Monica (cc’d) to start vendor setup and produce a sample invoice that matches your format. If marketplace is preferred, I’ll work with our partnerships team and loop back.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down so procurement can sign off.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@acme-analytics.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing & Procurement: PO vs Marketplace + Invoice Requirements

Hi Karhtik —

Thanks for the recap and for the clear list. Quick answers from procurement/finance:
- Commercial path: we prefer a direct PO to Redwood (vendor invoice) for this initial contract. Marketplace is something we can evaluate later but not today.
- Net terms: Net 30 is fine.
- Invoice fields: PO number needs to be on the invoice header (top right) and in the invoice metadata. Please also include our cost center (CC-3301) in the invoice body.
- Billing address / legal entity:
  Acme Analytics, Inc.
  Accounts Payable
  420 Market St, Suite 200
  San Francisco, CA 94105
  Tax ID: 94-1234567
  VAT ID: EU-987654321 (for UK/EU invoices)
- VAT/Tax: We need VAT shown on invoices when applicable and the VAT ID included. If Redwood needs to register in EU, we’ll coordinate that separately.
- Vendor setup: attaching our standard vendor form (Acme_VendorForm.pdf). Also, we require a W-9 or equivalent tax doc for US vendors.

Attaching the vendor form. Once you confirm Redwood can produce an invoice with PO on the header and include the cost center, we’ll issue PO-89241 and route to AP.

Regards,
Emily Roberts
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
emily.roberts@acme-analytics.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing & Procurement: PO vs Marketplace + Invoice Requirements

Hi all —

Thanks for the clarity, Emily. Sales Ops confirms:
- Invoice placement: we can include the PO number on the invoice header (top-right) and add an explicit line for your cost center (CC-3301).
- Net terms: Redwood supports Net 30 and can honor Net 30 for this deal.
- Tax/VAT: We can issue invoices that display VAT as a separate line when required. We currently collect customer VAT IDs and include them on the invoice. If Acme requires us to be VAT-registered in a specific EU country for local tax handling, that would be an additional ops/legal step — happy to coordinate, but not required for the invoice to include the VAT ID you provided.
- Required docs: please send the completed vendor setup form — attach vendor_setup_form.xlsx if you have it filled. We will also attach a W-9 (redwood_w9.pdf) to the vendor packet.

I’ve attached a sample invoice (sample-invoice.pdf) that matches the fields you requested — PO on the header, cost center included, billing address and VAT line. I’ve also created an internal ticket to ship our W-9 and vendor packet once the form is complete.

Next steps:
1) Emily: return the completed vendor_setup_form.xlsx and we’ll prepare the vendor record.
2) Once vendor is created, Emily/AP can issue PO-89241 to accounts-payable@redwood.com (we’ll share the vendor code).
3) We’ll send an initial invoice in PDF and electronic invoice metadata that your AP system can ingest.

Monica Patel
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
